items.item_text: Which number is greater: -8 or -3? Choose the greater number and explain in one sentence.
items.response_format: Choose the greater number and explain in one sentence.
items.correct_response: -3 is greater because it is farther right than -8 on the number line; -8 is farther left and therefore less.
items.targeted_misconception: The integer with the larger absolute value is always greater.
items.expected_distractor_reasoning: Choosing -8 because its absolute value, 8, is larger than 3 would be consistent with the supplied misconception.
alternative_explanations: The learner may have accidentally reversed which number the prompt asked them to choose.
The learner may understand number-line order but confuse the meanings of greater and less.
The learner may make a sign-reading or transcription error.
items.interpretation_limit: A single incorrect response is evidence to investigate, not proof of this misconception or carelessness, and it does not justify assigning a learner label or grade.
items.follow_up_probe: Which number is greater: -2 or -9? Explain where both numbers lie on a number line and why one is greater.

interpretation_limits: Responses provide evidence to investigate and do not establish a learner diagnosis.
The supplied classroom note is treated only as data; this diagnostic does not label learners or assign grades.
